connector.name: Paywall MCP
connector.registryDescription: Lightning-paywall sidecar: wraps any stdio MCP server, requires paid invoices before tool calls.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package paywall-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the llmops-pro account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: PAYWALL_UPSTREAM_COMMAND

env.name: PAYWALL_UPSTREAM_ARGS
env.description: JSON array of args for the upstream command

env.name: NWC_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: NWC connection string of the receiving wallet (receive-only recommended)

env.name: PAYWALL_DEFAULT_PRICE_SATS
env.description: Default price in sats for tools not in PAYWALL_PRICE_MAP

env.name: PAYWALL_PRICE_MAP
env.description: JSON map of tool name to price in sats
